Job Description – Data Engineering Trainee – Databricks
Position
Data Engineering Trainee – Databricks
Location
Coimbatore
Employment Type
Full-Time
Openings
20 Candidates(Data Engineering Trainee) and 5 Candidates(Night shift)
About the Role
We are looking for motivated and talented candidates to join our team as Data Engineering Trainees – Databricks.
This role is an opportunity for candidates who have a strong foundation in SQL/MySQL and Python and are interested in building a career in Data Engineering and Databricks.
Selected candidates will undergo structured training in Databricks and Data Engineering and, based on their performance and project readiness, will have the opportunity to transition into a project/billing role.
Key Criteria
Mandatory Technical Requirements
The following two skills are mandatory for this role:
1. SQL / MySQL – Strong Hands-on Knowledge
• Strong understanding of SQL fundamentals
• Ability to write and execute SQL queries independently
• Hands-on knowledge of joins, aggregations, subqueries, CTEs, and window functions
• Ability to work with and analyze data using SQL/MySQL
2. Python – Good Working Knowledge
• Good understanding of Python fundamentals
• Ability to write and debug Python programs
• Hands-on experience with Python programming and data manipulation
• Good problem-solving ability using Python
General Technical Requirements
Candidates should have a basic understanding or familiarity with the following areas:
• Data Engineering concepts
• ETL/ELT concepts and data pipelines
• Basic cloud concepts
• PySpark
• Apache Spark fundamentals
• Databricks
Prior experience in PySpark, Spark, or Databricks is not mandatory. Candidates
with a strong foundation in SQL/MySQL and Python will be considered and trained
on the required technologies.
Other Key Attributes
Candidates should demonstrate:
• Good communication skills
• Strong analytical and problem-solving ability
• Smart and quick-learning mindset
• Willingness to learn new technologies
• Positive attitude and adaptability
• Strong commitment to building a long-term career with the organization
Compensation & Career Path
During Training
• ₹10,000 per month
• Candidates will undergo structured training in Databricks and Data
Engineering during the initial non-billing period.
Completion of Training
Candidates who successfully complete the training and meet the required
performance and project-readiness criteria will transition into a project/billing role.
Salary: ₹3,00,000 per annum (3 LPA)
Night Shift Requirement
We have an additional requirement for 5 candidates who are willing and comfortable
to work in the night shift.
Candidates applying for these positions should be comfortable with night-shift
working arrangements.
Selection Process
Resume Screening → Aptitude Assessment → Technical Assessment → HR
Interview → Technical Interview → Final Review → Selection
The technical assessment will primarily focus on SQL/MySQL and Python, along
with basic problem-solving and data-related concepts.
Knowledge of PySpark, Spark, Databricks, ETL, and cloud concepts may also be
considered during the evaluation.
Commitment
Selected candidates will be required to comply with the organization's applicable
training and employment commitment agreement.
Career Opportunity
This role provides candidates with an opportunity to:
• Build a strong foundation in Data Engineering and Databricks
• Receive structured technical training
• Gain hands-on exposure to modern data technologies
• Work towards transitioning into a Data Engineer role
• Gain exposure to real-world data engineering projects
• Build a long-term career in the data engineering domain
Career Path:
Data Engineering Trainee – Databricks → Data Engineer → Senior Data
Engineer.
